title: Eventual coordinate surjectivity on twisted sections
statement: Let k be a field and P=Proj k[x_0,x_1] as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. For a coherent O_P-module G [pqf-def-coherent], there is an integer N>=0 such that for every z>=N and every section s of G tensor O_P(z+1), there are sections s0,s1 of G tensor O_P(z) with s=x0*s0+x1*s1. Multiplication is the map G whiskered with twistMul of [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. No finiteness assertion about sections or their direct sum is made.

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 01YS (4); coordinate split exact sequence on P1, checked on D+(x0) and D+(x1); online source read because local checkout is absent

proof.text: Apply the polynomial-Proj H1 vanishing theorem to G, obtaining an integer b. Choose N=(b+1).toNat. For z>=N, integer arithmetic gives z-1>=b, hence H1(G(z-1)) is subsingleton.

Use the coordinate short exact sequence with kernel G(z-1). Forget to abelian sheaves using the exact functor Scheme.Modules.toAb. In Ext.covariant_sequence_exact3, the boundary of any H0 class is zero because H1 of the kernel is subsingleton. Thus its class lifts to H0 of the biproduct.

Convert H0 to sections with H.zeroLinearEquiv and its naturality. Apply the two biproduct projections to the lifted section. Expand biprod.desc as fst followed by the first coordinate map plus snd followed by the second. Additivity of Hom.app gives exactly the asserted sum.

proof_origin.place: R3 Lean reduction of the existing coordinate-sequence/Serre-vanishing plan; exactness is Ext.covariant_sequence_exact3 and H0 naturality.
